title: Open the First Route Desk
briefing: Your first week kept you alive. The next step is controlled exploration: scan a nearby lead, read the field guide, track one route marker, and return before the weather turns.

objectives.label: Open the First-Month Route Desk
objectives.detail: Use Terminal What Now or Route Records to review the active route desk.

objectives.label: Scan the survivor cache signal
objectives.detail: Use Lens on the nearest cache signal or scanner-led salvage marker.

objectives.label: Read the field guide
objectives.detail: Open First-Month Routes or Field Caches in the Index before committing to the route.

objectives.label: Track one field marker
objectives.detail: Track Survivor Cache Signal or Ruined Plains Route from the HoloMap field intel layer.

objectives.label: Return and update What Now
objectives.detail: After the route, return to shelter and check Terminal for the next safe step.

completionText: Route desk online. Your next safe expansion should come from a scanned signal, a readable risk label, and a planned return path.
